# Future trend & significance map — sandbox (reads product **B**)

Standalone prototype for the **future-projection trend / significance map** described in
**CR-117** / **CR-119** dispatch
[`2026-06-12_publish-B-recommendation.md`](../../playbook/handovers/climateRationale/dispatches/2026-06-12_publish-B-recommendation.md).
It is **entirely separate** from `obs_month_overlay.qmd` — its own page, its own data layer — so
it can iterate without touching the CR-097/CR-116 sandbox or the production notebook.

Source: `ensemble_season_trends.parquet` (**B**) — per-(iso3 × admin1 × scenario × season × hazard × stat)
across-GCM ensemble `mean`/`sd`, `stat ∈ {value_slope, value_decade}`. iso3-first sorted /
prunable, single `baseline=1995-2014` variant (trend metrics are baseline-invariant).

```{ojs}
md`<details class="help-callout">
<summary>About this section — methodology & open caveats</summary>

This map renders the **ensemble-mean trend** of a NEX-GDDP-CMIP6 variable over a 20-year future window,
per admin1. Two open methodology points (relayed to the pipeline session, not yet confirmed in the
published file):

1. **Per-GCM-then-ensemble — CONFIRMED.** The slope is fit on *each GCM's* series (fit_keys include
   \`model\`), then mean/sd taken across GCMs (§3.7.1). Inter-model trend spread (\`sd\`) is preserved.
   Standing rule \`feedback_ensembling-is-always-last\` holds.
2. **Significance deferred — no overlay yet.** The pipeline dropped \`value_pval\` (mean-of-pvals is
   uninterpretable). B ships \`value_slope\` + \`value_decade\` only. The significance layer will be an
   **AR6 agreement metric** — \`pct_gcms_sig\` (frac GCMs with a significant slope) / \`pct_sign_pos\`
   (frac slope>0), computed per-GCM in §3.7.1, member-level pvals retained upstream so no refit is
   needed — landing later under **CR-117**. This map shows magnitude + inter-model sd only until then.
`
```

```{ojs}
// ── Shared deps (Quarto OJS provides DuckDBClient, Plot, d3, htl, Inputs) ──
topojson = require("topojson-client@3")
topoA1   = fetch("/data/shared/atlas_gaul24_a1_africa_simple-vlowres.topojson").then(r => r.json())
countriesRaw = FileAttachment("/data/shared/atlas_countries.json").json()
```

```{ojs}
// Country picker — Atlas countries flagged include:true, sorted by name.
countryOptions = countriesRaw
  .filter(c => c.include)
  .map(c => ({ iso3: c.iso3c, name: c.admin0_name }))
  .sort((a, b) => a.name.localeCompare(b.name))

viewof countrySel = Inputs.select(countryOptions, {
  label: "Country", format: d => d.name,
  value: countryOptions.find(c => c.iso3 === "AGO") ?? countryOptions[0],
})

viewof periodSel = Inputs.select(
  ["2021-2040", "2041-2060", "2061-2080", "2081-2100"],
  { label: "Future period", value: "2041-2060" })
```

```{ojs}
// ── Data layer (product B) ──────────────────────────────────────────────
// One small query per (country, period): pull every scenario×season×hazard×stat
// row for the country. iso3 = '<X>' single-value form so DuckDB-WASM prunes
// row-groups (B is iso3-first sorted). Everything else filters client-side off
// this cache. 404-safe: if B isn't published yet, returns [] and the banner shows.
trendBase = "https://digital-atlas.s3.amazonaws.com/domain=climate/type=hazard-indices/source=nex-gddp-cmip6/region=africa/processing=timeseries_mean_month/timeframe=3months"

db_trends = DuckDBClient.of()

trend_dataAll = {
  const iso3 = countrySel.iso3;
  const url = `${trendBase}/period=${periodSel}/baseline=1995-2014/variable=ensemble_season_trends.parquet`;
  const sql = `
    SELECT admin1_name, iso3, scenario, season, hazard, stat, mean, sd
    FROM read_parquet('${url}')
    WHERE iso3 = '${iso3}' AND admin1_name IS NOT NULL`;
  try {
    const rows = Array.from(await db_trends.query(sql));
    return { ok: true, rows };
  } catch (err) {
    return { ok: false, rows: [], error: (err && err.message) ? err.message : String(err) };
  }
}
```

```{ojs}
// Selector options derive from whatever B actually contains (empty until published).
_distinct = (key) => [...new Set(trend_dataAll.rows.map(r => r[key]))].filter(Boolean).sort()
scenarioOptions = _distinct("scenario")
seasonOptions   = _distinct("season")
hazardOptions   = _distinct("hazard")
```

```{ojs}
viewof scenarioSel = Inputs.select(scenarioOptions.length ? scenarioOptions : ["—"], { label: "Scenario (SSP)" })
viewof seasonSel   = Inputs.select(seasonOptions.length   ? seasonOptions   : ["—"], { label: "Season" })
viewof hazardSel   = Inputs.select(hazardOptions.length   ? hazardOptions   : ["—"], { label: "Variable" })
viewof statSel     = Inputs.radio(["value_decade", "value_slope"], { label: "Trend stat", value: "value_decade" })
// Significance overlay intentionally absent: B ships value_slope + value_decade
// only (pipeline dropped the mean-of-pvals as uninterpretable, 2026-06-12). The
// AR6 agreement metric (pct_gcms_sig / pct_sign_pos) lands later under CR-117 —
// wire it here as a fade/hatch when it arrives.
```

```{ojs}
// Pivot the long-format cache to one record per admin1 for the active selection:
// { admin1_name -> { value_slope, value_decade, value_pval, sd_<stat> } }
trendByAdmin = {
  const sel = trend_dataAll.rows.filter(r =>
    r.scenario === scenarioSel && r.season === seasonSel && r.hazard === hazardSel);
  const m = new Map();
  for (const r of sel) {
    if (!m.has(r.admin1_name)) m.set(r.admin1_name, {});
    const o = m.get(r.admin1_name);
    o[r.stat] = r.mean;
    o[`sd_${r.stat}`] = r.sd;
  }
  return m;
}
```

```{ojs}
// Variable-aware diverging palette: wet vars (PTOT/SPEI) positive=wetter=blue;
// temperature positive=warmer=red. value_pval would be sequential, but the radio
// only exposes slope/decade — pval drives the significance fade instead.
isWetVar = (hazardSel || "").startsWith("PTOT") || (hazardSel || "").startsWith("SPEI")

trendMap = {
  if (!trend_dataAll.ok) {
    return htl.html`<div class="trend-banner warn">
      <strong>Product B not reachable.</strong> <code>ensemble_season_trends.parquet</code> for
      period <code>${periodSel}</code> returned an error — most likely it isn't published to S3 yet
      (the pipeline session flagged it as in-progress on 2026-06-12). This scaffold lights up
      automatically once the key exists.<br><small>${trend_dataAll.error ?? ""}</small></div>`;
  }
  if (!trend_dataAll.rows.length)
    return htl.html`<div class="trend-banner warn">No B rows for <strong>${countrySel.name}</strong> / ${periodSel}.</div>`;

  const features = topojson.feature(topoA1, topoA1.objects["atlas_gaul24_a1_africa"]).features
    .filter(f => f.properties.iso3 === countrySel.iso3);
  if (!features.length) return htl.html`<p style="color:#c00">No admin1 geometry for ${countrySel.name}.</p>`;

  const vals = features
    .map(f => trendByAdmin.get(f.properties.admin1_name)?.[statSel])
    .filter(v => v != null);
  const absMax = d3.max(vals, Math.abs) || 1;
  const scale = d3.scaleLinear().domain([-absMax, absMax]).range([0, 1]);
  const colour = (v) => {
    if (v == null) return "#ddd";
    const t = scale(v);
    // wet: positive=blue (t); temp: positive=red (1-t)
    return d3.interpolateRdBu(isWetVar ? t : 1 - t);
  };

  const fc = { type: "FeatureCollection", features };
  const width = 720, height = 560;

  const plot = Plot.plot({
    width, height,
    projection: { type: "mercator", domain: fc },
    marks: [
      Plot.geo(features, {
        fill: f => colour(trendByAdmin.get(f.properties.admin1_name)?.[statSel]),
        stroke: "#fff", strokeWidth: 0.5,
        title: f => {
          const o = trendByAdmin.get(f.properties.admin1_name) ?? {};
          const v = o[statSel];
          const sd = o[`sd_${statSel}`];
          return `${f.properties.admin1_name}\n${statSel}: ${v != null ? v.toFixed(3) : "—"}`
               + `\ninter-model sd: ${sd != null ? sd.toFixed(3) : "—"}`;
        },
      }),
    ],
  });

  const unit = statSel === "value_decade" ? "per decade" : "per year";
  return htl.html`<div>
    ${plot}
    <div class="trend-legend">
      <span><span class="swatch" style="background:${d3.interpolateRdBu(isWetVar ? 1 : 0)}"></span>${isWetVar ? "wetter / increasing" : "warmer / increasing"}</span>
      <span><span class="swatch" style="background:${d3.interpolateRdBu(0.5)}"></span>~no change</span>
      <span><span class="swatch" style="background:${d3.interpolateRdBu(isWetVar ? 0 : 1)}"></span>${isWetVar ? "drier / decreasing" : "cooler / decreasing"}</span>
      <span><span class="swatch" style="background:#ddd"></span>no data</span>
      <span style="opacity:.55">significance overlay pending — AR6 agreement metric (pct_gcms_sig) under CR-117</span>
    </div>
    <p style="font-size:.8rem;color:#666;margin-top:.4rem">
      ${hazardSel} · ${scenarioSel} · ${seasonSel} · ${periodSel} · trend ${unit} (ensemble mean across GCMs)
    </p>
  </div>`;
}
```
